summary: The PrintJobReportParameters class is used to manage parameters for print jobs within the HSPnet system. It retrieves and processes parameter values associated with a specific print job, and subsequently deletes the print job once processing is complete.
purpose: To handle and process parameters for print jobs, facilitating the extraction, processing, and clean-up of print job data.

fields.name: ParamName
fields.description: The name of the print job parameter.

fields.name: ParamValue
fields.description: The value associated with the print job parameter.

workflows.name: PrintJob Parameter Processing
steps: Retrieve all parameters for a specific PrintJobID using PrintJobGetAllParameters method.
Iterate over the list of parameters.
Concatenate the parameter values if ParamName equals 'PRD_ID'.
Delete the print job using PrintJobs.PrintJobDelete.

business_rules: Only parameters with the ParamName 'PRD_ID' are concatenated into the return string.
system_behavior: Allows retrieving and deleting print job parameters from the database.
